Every work below is one the workshop leans on. Some are books it assumes. Some
are papers a section implements. Some are libraries it tells you to use in place
of your own code. None of them is here to pad a bibliography.

Read it two ways. **Before or during the session**, it is where a term you have
just met is defined properly. **After the session**, it is the ladder out. Start
with the survey. Then read whichever of the four papers covers the decomposition
you ended up needing.

{{< include _includes/references-en.md >}}

## Not on this page {#elsewhere}

- **[Prerequisites](index.qmd#prerequisites)** — the pre-work, in full, on the
  homepage. That is the one list to work through *before* the session; this
  page is for after it.
- **[The handbook](tensors_workshop_plan_with_quizzes.md)** — the workshop's
  own text, including the five take-home appendices. It cites the works above
  where each one is first needed.
- **[The machine-generated companion](companion.qmd)** — a video,
  infographics, an audio overview, a quiz, flashcards and a mind map. NotebookLM
  generated them all from this workshop's own sources. It is *generated, not
  written*, so use it as a second pass. Where it disagrees with a work on this
  page, the work is right.
